name: deploy-then-verify
description: Deploy a service and PROVE it works by requesting the live health endpoint — exit code 0 is never accepted as success on its own.
requirements: a deployed HTTP service with a health endpoint
network access to the live URL
procedure: run the deploy command and capture the real exit code
request the live health URL (curl -fsS) and record the HTTP status + body
if the request fails or returns a non-200, treat the deploy as FAILED even when the command exited 0
record the verified live URL and verification evidence in the world model

examples.situation: npm deploy exits 0 but site returns 502
examples.outcome: skill reports FAILED with the 502 evidence

failureModes: health endpoint exists but checks nothing real (false confidence)
verifying a staging URL instead of production
verification: a real HTTP request to the live URL returning the expected status — evidence recorded, never assumed
